note: Source review on 2026-11-23: llm-d-router v1.0.0 (latest published release checked) and main at 8f372a856464be9cf6fb009b6b433d43af531ddb; related vLLM-Omni main at 964e65d5d4ddb68e1fcfd6143d8cf29be6e683af and latency-predictor main at 51e801acb515d2cd49342ce63da04ffd5cea0f7c. The dashboard does not detect deployed versions or validate parser/producer output, metric mappings, backend cache hits, predictor health or training. ok means no applicable caveat was found, not verified operability. Caveats use the current configuration and cluster view, not a historical run snapshot. Unknown and limited caveats warn but do not suppress Compare winner highlighting; the worst applicable caveat is inherited by a mixed profile, although its other scorers may still contribute useful signals.

requirements.missing_reason: Predictor sidecars not found in the EPP pod; training and prediction servers can instead run as services. Verify their configured URLs, readiness, training samples and predictions.

caveats.reason: Verify reachable predictor training and prediction servers, workload-appropriate samples and predictions, and streamingMode. Container presence alone does not prove predictor health. For embeddings, estimate-backed token production handles text; the checked vLLM render backend does not handle this request body.

v0.11.0/v1.0.0 estimate backend cannot process TTS. Main with PR #3712 estimates text input; the vLLM render backend does not. Verify deployed code, predictor samples, predictions and streaming metrics for audio.

Image prompt estimation requires a build with PR #3721 and the estimate backend; output size and inference steps are not estimated. Verify predictor samples and predictions for this non-streaming workload.

PR #3721 adds prompt estimation; PR #4054 adds uploaded-image input estimation on main. Output-generation cost remains outside that estimate. Verify deployed build, producer and predictor samples for edits.

v1.0.0 falls through to passthrough. Main with PR #3964 (merged November 16) parses multipart audio and estimates duration-based input via the estimate backend; the vLLM render backend does not handle this body. Verify deployed parser, producer, predictor samples and whether streaming observations represent transcript latency.

Verify per-endpoint metrics and prediction coverage. Checked main skips predictions for never-scraped endpoints; with partial coverage, endpoints lacking predictions are ranked behind predicted candidates. With no predictions the scorer uses a KV/queue/prefix composite fallback. Encoder-cache predictor features are opt-in (useEncoderCacheFeatures=false by default); first-body and subsequent stream observations need not be first useful audio/text or engine-token timings.

Text embeddings use the estimate backend on checked main, but its pseudo-tokens do not establish actual backend KV-cache reuse; the vLLM render backend does not handle this body. Verify deployed producer, backend cache behavior and scores.

TTS estimates are absent in v0.11.0/v1.0.0. Main with PR #3712 supports estimate-backed approximate matching; PR #4059 salts the fingerprint with full input and conditioning, so a shared text prefix or changed voice need not match. Randomized conditioning can isolate identical requests. Verify deployed producer and backend reuse; pseudo-tokens do not enable precise KV-event matching.
Image prompt estimation requires PR #3721 and the estimate backend. Approximate prefix matches do not establish actual diffusion/backend cache reuse; verify the deployed version and producer.

PR #3721 estimates edit prompts; PR #4054 adds uploaded-image features on main. Verify the deployed build, producer and actual backend cache behavior; estimated matches are not precise KV-event matches.

v1.0.0 supplies no transcription input via the default passthrough parser. Main with merged PR #3964 and the estimate backend supplies audio pseudo-tokens and a media hash for approximate matching. This does not establish precise KV-event matching or actual repeated-audio backend cache reuse.
The estimate backend handles text embeddings, but the checked vLLM render backend does not. Verify deployed producer and endpoint length ranges; pseudo-token counts are approximate.
TTS estimates are absent in v0.11.0/v1.0.0. Main with PR #3712 estimates input text using pseudo-tokens; the render backend does not handle TTS. Verify producer and endpoint length ranges.
Prompt estimation requires PR #3721 and the estimate backend. Input length is approximate and does not measure output image size or generation steps.
PR #3721 estimates edit text; PR #4054 adds uploaded-image input estimation on main. Neither establishes output-generation cost or exact model context length; verify deployed version and ranges.

Main with merged PR #3964 and the estimate backend estimates uploaded audio length; v1.0.0 falls through to passthrough and the checked vLLM render backend does not handle this body. A duration header overrides payload duration; PCM WAV headers can supply duration, while other formats use byte-rate estimates. Verify token rates, caps and endpoint ranges; pseudo-tokens are not exact engine context length.
Estimate-backed text embedding input is supported on checked main; the vLLM render backend does not handle this body. Verify the deployed producer and overlapping-request scores.

TTS input estimates are absent in v0.11.0/v1.0.0. Main with PR #3712 and the estimate backend estimates input text; the vLLM render backend does not handle TTS. Main with PR #4382 also estimates output codec frames from spoken-input byte length when addEstimatedOutputTokens is enabled (default false). This heuristic is capped and does not measure actual audio duration or GPU cost; verify deployed settings and scores.
Prompt estimation requires PR #3721 and the estimate backend; it does not measure image output size or inference steps. Verify deployed version and input estimates.
PR #3721 estimates edit text; PR #4054 adds uploaded-image input estimation on main. The estimate omits output-generation cost; verify deployed version and producer.

Main with merged PR #3964 and the estimate backend supplies duration-based audio input; v1.0.0 falls through to passthrough. A duration header overrides payload duration; PCM WAV headers can supply duration, while other formats use byte-rate estimates. Verify deployed parser, producer, token rates/caps and overlapping-request scores; the checked vLLM render backend does not handle this body.

Verify inflight-load-producer accounting, not only tokenization. With addEstimatedOutputTokens=false (default), input load is released at the first response-body signal, or earlier on a compatible configured KV event, so ongoing generation may no longer contribute token load. Prefix-match data can discount input even without a prefix scorer in the selected profile. Output estimates are optional heuristics; non-text cost weighting in PR #2967 remains unmerged at the review commit.

The estimate backend handles text embeddings, but the checked vLLM render backend does not handle this request body. Verify the deployed token and prefix producers; without match data requests are treated as cold.

TTS estimates are absent in v0.11.0/v1.0.0. Main with PR #3712 supports estimate-backed approximate matching; PR #4059 salts the fingerprint with full input and conditioning, so a shared text prefix or changed voice need not match. Randomized conditioning can isolate identical requests. Verify deployed producer and backend reuse; pseudo-tokens do not enable precise KV-event matching. Without match data all requests are treated as cold, testing LRU spreading.
Without meaningful prefix-match data, requests are treated as cold and only LRU spreading is tested. Image prompt estimates require PR #3721; backend cache reuse remains unverified.
Without meaningful prefix-match data, requests are treated as cold. PR #4054 adds uploaded-image estimates on main; verify the deployed producer and backend cache behavior.

Main with merged PR #3964 and the estimate backend can supply audio-derived approximate prefix data; v1.0.0 defaults to passthrough. Without match data requests are treated as cold, testing LRU spreading. Validate presumed warm and cold cases; an estimated hit does not prove backend audio-cache reuse.
This tool sends text input for this endpoint, with no input media for multimodal encoder-cache reuse.

Main with PR #4054 and the estimate backend can supply an uploaded-image feature. For this route the cache producer needs token-produced media metadata. Verify deployed producers, modeled cache capacity and whether the image backend actually reuses encoder outputs; a predicted match is not an engine hit.

Main with merged PR #3964 and the estimate backend can supply an uploaded-audio feature; v1.0.0 defaults to passthrough. For this route the cache producer needs token-produced media metadata. Verify deployed producers, modeled cache capacity and actual backend encoder-cache reuse; a predicted match is not an engine hit.

Verify a meaningful per-endpoint KV metric and its stage labels. Checked main adds a built-in vllm-omni engine mapping for pipeline waiting/running counts but deliberately leaves KV usage unmapped; a successful scrape can then leave KV usage at zero and yield tied high scores. A custom AR-stage mapping may supply KV data, but it does not measure the whole multimodal pipeline or total GPU load. The dashboard does not inspect the mapping.
